Class ShapeClipperTriangulation2D

Namespace
ShapeEngine.ShapeClipper
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Provides Clipper-backed triangulation helpers for polygons, polygon outlines, and polyline strokes in 2D.

Remarks

These helpers build TriMesh or Triangulation results from world-space polygon data, reusing shared intermediate buffers together with services exposed by ShapeClipper2D. The class is intended for sequential use and is not thread-safe.

CreatePolygonOutlineTriangulation(Paths64, float, float, bool, bool, TriMesh)

Triangulates the stroked outline of a Clipper polygon-with-holes input into a TriMesh.

public static void CreatePolygonOutlineTriangulation(Paths64 polygonWithHoles, float thickness, float miterLimit, bool beveled, bool useDelaunay, TriMesh result)

Parameters

polygonWithHoles Paths64

The closed Clipper paths representing the outer polygon and any holes.

thickness float

The outline thickness in world units.

miterLimit float

The maximum miter length factor used for sharp joins.

beveled bool

Whether joins that exceed the miter limit should use beveled corners.

useDelaunay bool

Whether Delaunay refinement should be applied during triangulation.

result TriMesh

The destination mesh that receives the generated geometry.

Remarks

The outline is produced by offsetting the input paths outward and inward, subtracting the inner result from the outer result, and triangulating the resulting ring paths.

CreatePolygonOutlineTriangulationMasked(Paths64, Paths64, float, float, bool, bool, bool, TriMesh)

Triangulates the outline of Clipper paths after subtracting mask paths from them, writing the result into a TriMesh.

public static void CreatePolygonOutlineTriangulationMasked(Paths64 polygonWithHoles, Paths64 masks, float thickness, float miterLimit, bool beveled, bool useDelaunay, bool keepHoles, TriMesh result)

Parameters

polygonWithHoles Paths64

The closed source paths whose outline should be triangulated.

masks Paths64

The closed mask paths to subtract from polygonWithHoles.

thickness float

The outline thickness in world units.

miterLimit float

The maximum miter length factor used for sharp joins.

beveled bool

Whether joins that exceed the miter limit should use beveled corners.

useDelaunay bool

Whether Delaunay refinement should be applied during triangulation.

keepHoles bool

Whether holes produced by the mask difference should be preserved before outline generation.

result TriMesh

The destination mesh that receives the generated geometry.

Remarks

The method first subtracts masks from polygonWithHoles, optionally removes holes from the clipped result, and then generates and triangulates an outline from the remaining closed paths.

CreatePolygonTriangulationMasked(Paths64, Paths64, bool, TriMesh)

Triangulates Clipper paths after subtracting mask paths from them, writing the filled result into a TriMesh.

public static void CreatePolygonTriangulationMasked(Paths64 polygonWithHoles, Paths64 masks, bool useDelaunay, TriMesh result)

Parameters

polygonWithHoles Paths64

The closed source paths to triangulate.

masks Paths64

The closed mask paths to subtract from polygonWithHoles.

useDelaunay bool

Whether Delaunay refinement should be applied during triangulation.

result TriMesh

The destination mesh that receives the generated geometry.

Remarks

The input is assumed to already be in Clipper path space. The method performs a difference operation and triangulates the remaining closed paths.

CreatePolygonTriangulationMasked(IReadOnlyList<Vector2>, IReadOnlyList<Vector2>, bool, TriMesh)

Triangulates a polygon after subtracting a mask polygon from it, writing the filled result into a TriMesh.

public static void CreatePolygonTriangulationMasked(IReadOnlyList<Vector2> polygonCCW, IReadOnlyList<Vector2> polygonMask, bool useDelaunay, TriMesh result)

Parameters

polygonCCW IReadOnlyList<Vector2>

The source polygon vertices, expected in counterclockwise order.

polygonMask IReadOnlyList<Vector2>

The polygon vertices to subtract from the source polygon.

useDelaunay bool

Whether Delaunay refinement should be applied during triangulation.

result TriMesh

The destination mesh that receives the generated geometry.

Remarks

Both polygons are converted to Clipper paths, combined using a difference operation, and the resulting closed paths are triangulated.
